info.name: PhonePe PG Payment Links Via Autopay
info.description:
PhonePe Payment Gateway - Payment Links Via Autopay.

Introduction: Set up a UPI Autopay mandate through a shareable payment link (SMS/Email). The customer opens the link, authorises the mandate, and you later notify + execute recurring redemptions against it. Useful when you cannot integrate the checkout SDK directly.

Folders:
- Authorization -> Get Access Token
- Subscription Setup -> Setup Subscription (Paylink)
- Redemption -> Notify Redemption, Execute Redemption
- Status -> Order Status
- Webhooks (Mock Server)

Credentials: set client_id, client_version, client_secret and tsp_env in the environment; the access token is fetched/refreshed automatically.

Environments:
- Sandbox: https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox/<Endpoint>
- Production: Authorization API https://api.phonepe.com/apis/identity-manager/<Endpoint> ; Other APIs https://api.phonepe.com/apis/pg/<Endpoint>

API Endpoints:
- Authorization        POST /v1/oauth/token
- Setup Subscription   POST /paylinks/v1/pay
- Notify Redemption    POST /checkout/v2/subscriptions/notify
- Execute Redemption   POST /checkout/v2/subscriptions/redeem
- Order Status         GET  /checkout/v2/order/{merchantOrderId}/status

Docs: https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/autopay/paylinks-autopay/api-integration/

exec: throw new Error('Missing access_token. Run Authorization/Get Access Token first.');

request.description: Generate the O-Bearer access token required to authenticate all Paylinks-Autopay requests.
Create a payment link that sets up a UPI Autopay mandate. Returns orderId + paylinkUrl + state ACTIVE. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/autopay/paylinks-autopay/api-integration/

Notify the customer of an upcoming debit (mandatory 24h before execution). Returns orderId + state NOTIFICATION_IN_PROGRESS. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/autopay/paylinks-autopay/api-integration/
Execute the notified redemption (after the mandatory 24h gap). Returns transactionId + state PENDING. https://developer.phonepe.com/payment-gateway/autopay/paylinks-autopay/api-integration/
Fetch the status of a setup or redemption order by merchantOrderId.
